answer: Because the timing is published against the copper challenge, the knoll audit can replay the yarrow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 184 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 2752 identities would post 576 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
